caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass object, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The glass appears to be a candlestick holder or similar vessel, colored in a pale aqua or light bluish-green tint. It consists of a cylindrical vertical section at the top, which flares outward at the rim. Below the cylinder, the stem is formed by a series of four rounded, bulbous segments stacked vertically. The base is a wide, circular disk that gently curves upward near the stem’s attachment point, creating a small rim. The glass surface reflects light with subtle highlights and shadows, indicating its smooth, translucent quality. The bottom left corner of the image contains a handwritten signature.
title: Candlestick
